description: Sets or removes an environment's variables and secrets (in the vault by default, never read back); they apply at the next deployment. get_environment { view: "variables" } reads their names.

build.description: true: a build secret (build.secrets, e.g. NPM_TOKEN), read by builds only, never by the app. With delete: removes one.

delete.description: Names of the variables or secrets to delete from this environment.

file.description: true: a secret delivered as a file, never as a variable: the app reads it in /run/secrets/<NAME>. Required for a secret in the production of a project linked to a federated connection.

key.description: A single variable: its name (with "value"), instead of "values".

move.description: A name: this secret moves to the build (build: true) or to the app, its value kept in the vault.

secret.description: true: in the vault, never read back (default). false: plain variable, readable on screen.

trial.description: The key returned by the first deploy_app (trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: set_env
title: Set variables and secrets
